HeroBanner.Title: Cricket
HeroBanner.TitleHighlight: PRO TOURNAMENT SPEC • ENGLISH & KASHMIR WILLOW
HeroBanner.Subtitle: Handcrafted cricket bats, lightweight batting pads, ventilated gloves, and leather match balls designed for university leagues.

Products.Name: Handcrafted Kashmir Willow Power Cricket Bat
Products.Description: Pre-knocked Kashmir Willow bat with thick 38mm edges, enlarged sweet spot, natural cane handle and protective toe guard.

Products.Name: Grade 1 English Willow Tournament Match Bat
Products.Description: Hand-selected Grade 1 English Willow with 7-9 straight grains, feather-light balanced pickup, and premium chevron grip.

Products.Name: Four-Piece Alum-Tanned Leather Match Cricket Ball
Products.Description: Tournament spec 156g 4-piece alum tanned leather ball with cork core, hand-stitched 80-stitch seam for 50-over match play.

Products.Name: High-Density Foam Lightweight Batting Legguards
Products.Description: Molded ultra-lightweight high-density foam pads with reinforced cane vertical bolsters, instep protection, and sweat-absorbing toweling.

Products.Name: Ventilated Sheepskin Leather Batting Gloves (Pair)
Products.Description: Supple sheepskin leather palm with multi-flex ergonomic finger cuts, high-density fiber inserts, and dual-sided sweatbands.

Products.Name: High-Impact Cricket Helmet with Steel Visor
Products.Description: BSI certified cricket helmet with shock-absorbing EPS liner, adjustable powder-coated steel grill, and dial-fit adjustment strap.

Products.Name: Full-Size Cricket Kit Bag with Heavy-Duty Tractor Wheels
Products.Description: 1680D ballistic nylon wheelie kit bag with 2 integrated bat pockets, footwear tunnel, dual padded haul handles, and tractor wheels.

Products.Name: Solid Wood Cricket Stumps Set with Bails & Heavy Metal Base
Products.Description: Tournament height seasoned hardwood stumps with precision turned bails, cast-iron spring-free heavy base for indoor and turf nets.

SubcategoryPages.ImportantNote: Match balls feature thermal-bonded seamless PU shells with butyl bladders for optimal trajectory in all weather conditions.

Products.Description: 6-meter 12-rung adjustable agility ladder with 10 high-visibility disc cones, ground pegs, and durable carry pouch.

Products.Description: Dual full-length zippered compartments with thermal insulation foil lining to protect string tension from hot and cold temperature swings.

Products.Description: 0.6mm ultra-thin high-tack polyurethane overgrips with moisture-wicking micro-perforations to prevent sweaty palm slip during games.
